name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
description: Mickey and pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse for all-new adventures filled with songs, laughs, handy helping, and fun new surprises.

videos.title: Mickey's Country Farm
videos.overview: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy’s cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.

videos.title: Mickey's New Helper
videos.overview: Mickey and pals meet Little Helper, a handy helping friend. When it floats away in a glove balloon, they race to rescue it using their Mouseketools!

videos.title: Clarabelle's New Coop
videos.overview: When Clarabelle's coop is wrecked, Mickey and friends rebuild it using Mouseketools, giving her chickens a new, improved home!

videos.title: Goofy's Sock Hunt
videos.overview: Goofy's socks vanish during naps, and soon Mickey's stuff goes missing too! They find Pluto gathering items to build a cozy bed for a mama cat and her kittens.

videos.title: Puppy Pluto
videos.overview: Professor Von Drake's Itty Bitty Baby Ray turns him and Pluto into babies! Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to reverse the shrink ray.

videos.title: Goofy Pizza
videos.overview: Goofy's hungry for pizza, but the fridge is missing ingredients. Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to gather what's needed and make a delicious pizza to share!

videos.title: Minnie's Tune Train
videos.overview: Professor Von Drake gifts a calliope car for the Clubhouse Choo-Choo train. Minnie performs a song, and she and Mickey help friends finish chores to join in.

videos.title: Please the Bees
videos.overview: Donald shakes a beehive, upsetting the bees. They buzz after him, but Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to build a new hive and calm them down.

videos.title: Minnie's Dinner Party
videos.overview: The pals help Minnie throw a dinner party for Clara Cluck. Using Mouseketools, they set the table, dress up in hats, and finish cooking before guests arrive.

videos.title: Minnie's Backpack Adventure
videos.overview: Minnie makes special backpacks, inspiring a hike to Goofy Rock. Using Mouseketools, they reach the top where Goofy climbs his namesake rock for a photo.

videos.title: Mickey's Mail Mix-Up
videos.overview: Dozens of letters and packages arrive at the Clubhouse by mistake. Mickey and Minnie find out that Von Drake's mail-sorting invention is broken.

videos.title: Daisy Can’t Say
videos.overview: Daisy's pals get tea to help her lost voice heal.

videos.title: Minnie Mouse Clubhouse
videos.overview: When the Clubhouse is busy, Minnie can't use the kitchen or Anywhere Areas. Mickey surprises her with her own pink Clubhouse, thanks to Von Drake's invention.

videos.title: The Ice Cream Mystery
videos.overview: Go-Getters use gadgets to find the missing ice cream.

videos.title: Say Cheese
videos.overview: Mickey and pals take photos for a gallery wall.

videos.title: Daisy's Hole in One Mystery
videos.overview: Mouseketools help fix gopher holes.

videos.title: Mickey and Pluto Go Camping
videos.overview: Mickey's pals surprise him at Friendship Lake camp.

videos.title: Martian Mickey's Clubhouse
videos.overview: Mickey helps Martians build their own clubhouse.

videos.title: Martian Mishap
videos.overview: When Martian Mickey crash-lands on Earth, Mickey and pals help him repair his spaceship so he can safely return home.

videos.title: Minnie's Rubber Ducky Doozy
videos.overview: Minnie organises a rubber duck parade on the lake. When Goofy's duck goes missing, the Sensational Six dive into the water with Mouse Tools to find it.

videos.title: SPOTS the Beagle-Bot
videos.overview: Gang helps a robot dog learn to play with Pluto.

videos.title: Mickey's Movie Night
videos.overview: Mickey and pals help Pete at his movie theater.

videos.title: Clubhouse Carnival
videos.overview: Mickey and pals search for Donald's lost toy lion.

videos.title: Tale of the Moo-Maids
videos.overview: The pals dive to find Daisy's pearls with Sea Queen.

videos.title: Daisylocks and the Three Bears
videos.overview: Mickey guides Daisylocks home.

videos.title: A Dragon Tale
videos.overview: A tea party is disrupted by a dragon.

videos.title: The Late, Late Show
videos.overview: The pals try to stay awake for the meteor shower.

videos.title: Donald's Clubhouse Sleepover
videos.overview: Mickey and pals help Donald get a good night's sleep.

videos.title: The Candy Cottage
videos.overview: Pals gather candy to fix Wizard Pete's candy cottage.
